caption.text:
Azis Suraji, warga Pancoran Mas, Depok, ngaku dapat tindakan tak menyenangkan dari tetangganya sejak 2024. Rumahnya pernah dilempari telur, sampah, sampai helm, motornya pun rusak. Suraji bilang tak tahu pemicu kelakukan tetangganya itu. Ancaman verbal dan ajakan berkelahi juga dialami Suraji, tapi katanya dia tak merespons. Kini cucunya takut kalau keluar rumah, juga anak-istrinya. Suraji bilang dia tak pernah campuri urusan tetangganya, termasuk soal musik suara keras. Kini dia lapor polisi. Juga niat mau jual rumah karena merasa tak nyaman.⁠
⁠
📸: Dok. Istimewa.⁠

caption.text_translation:
Azis Suraji, a resident of Pancoran Mas, Depok, admitted to receiving unpleasant actions from his neighbors since 2024. His house was once thrown by eggs, garbage, even the helmet, and his motorbike were broken. Suraji said he didn't know the trigger did that to his neighbor. Verbal threats and fighting calls were also experienced by Suraji, but he said he didn't respond. Now his grandson is afraid to go out, so are his daughters. Suraji says he never interferes in his neighbor's affairs, including that of loud music. Now he is reporting the police. Also intend to sell the house because feeling uncomfortable.

 📸: Dok. Istimewa.
